core.command: mise exec -- cargo test --locked --offline -p gpui-box --features retained-text,retained-wgpu

gallery.command: mise exec -- cargo test --locked --offline -p gpui-box-example-hello --features retained-wgpu -- --include-ignored

clippy.command: mise exec -- cargo clippy --locked --offline -p gpui-box -p gpui-box-example-hello -p gpui-box-rendering-perf --features gpui-box-example-hello/retained-wgpu,gpui-box-rendering-perf/retained-gpu --all-targets -- -D warnings

scope: Windows hardware only; CPU structure controls unchanged. No rebind performance or cross-platform claim.
